{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = '/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv'
sales_df = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Convert revenue to float, replacing non-numeric with NaN
sales_df['revenue'] = pd.to_numeric(sales_df['revenue'], errors='coerce')

# Drop rows where revenue is NaN (6 rows)
sales_df = sales_df.dropna(subset=['revenue'])

# Confirm the drop
print('After dropping NaN revenue, shape:', sales_df.shape)

# Check if all remaining revenue values are non-negative
print('Any negative revenue? ', (sales_df['revenue'] < 0).any())

# Verify the 'converted' column is binary (0 or 1)
print('Converted unique values:', sales_df['converted'].unique())"}
